# Oxyniti

> Oxyniti builds nano-bubble oxygen generators for aquaculture, raising dissolved oxygen in fish and shrimp ponds to improve survival rate, feed conversion, and stocking density. Currently serving Tamil Nadu and South India.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.oxyniti.com/): Overview, profit calculator, and FAQ.
- [Products](https://www.oxyniti.com/products): Nano-bubble generator product lineup.
- [Technology](https://www.oxyniti.com/technology): How nano-bubble oxygenation works.
- [Aquaculture Oxygenation](https://www.oxyniti.com/aquaculture-oxygenation): Oxygenation for fish ponds.
- [RAS Oxygenation](https://www.oxyniti.com/ras-oxygenation): Oxygenation for recirculating aquaculture systems.
